description: Token engine (packages/tickets/src/lib/titleTokens.ts) exports listTokens(template) returning every {{token}} in first-seen order

Token engine exports formatCalendarDate(ymd, locale, style), a floating-UTC calendar-date formatter with locale fallback to en; ticketTitleTokens.ts {{due_date}}/{{month}}/{{year}} use it with unchanged output
getServiceRequestTemplateFields(formSchema) returns { key, label, type } for every non-file-upload field in form order
findUnknownServiceRequestTemplateTokens(template, formSchema) returns tokens that are not insertable fields, including file-upload keys; tolerates whitespace inside braces
renderServiceRequestTemplate renders short-text/long-text answers as trimmed strings
renderServiceRequestTemplate renders a select answer as its option label, falling back to the raw value when no option matches
renderServiceRequestTemplate renders a YYYY-MM-DD date answer as a long-style floating calendar date in the supplied locale; unparseable values render raw
renderServiceRequestTemplate renders a checkbox answer as the supplied localized yes/no labels
renderServiceRequestTemplate renders missing/hidden answers, unknown tokens and file-upload tokens as empty text and never throws
normalizeTicketSubject collapses all whitespace (including newlines), trims, and caps at 255 characters (254 + ellipsis, code-point safe)
ServiceRequestExecutionContext carries formSchema; submissionService passes the published version's form schema snapshot
Ticket-only provider resolves the tenant default locale (on the provider transaction via new optional knex arg to getTenantDefaultLocale) and common yes/no labels once per execution

buildTicketTitle renders titleTemplate through the shared renderer; empty result falls back to titleFieldKey, first non-empty string answer, then 'Service Request <id8>'; final subject from any branch is normalized and capped
buildTicketDescription renders descriptionPrefix placeholders with the shared renderer, preserving line breaks; answer summary unchanged

New standard component @alga-psa/ui/components/TemplateTokenInput: input (or TextArea when multiline) plus Insert field DropdownMenu listing { token, label, secondary } items, inserting {{token}} at the caret / replacing selection / completing a started {{ / appending when no caret, with an error slot

Ticket Routing panel replaces 'Title Field Key' with a full-width 'Ticket subject' TemplateTokenInput whose menu lists form fields by label (key as secondary text), with helper text and new msp/service-requests strings in all locales
Description prefix uses TemplateTokenInput (multiline) with the same Insert field menu
Editor shows an inline unknown-field error under the subject template and description prefix
Save Ticket Routing and Save All refuse to save routing while unknown tokens exist (toast / failures list)
editorHelpers: TicketRoutingConfigInput uses titleTemplate; buildTicketRoutingExecutionConfig writes titleTemplate when non-blank and always removes legacy titleFieldKey
editorHelpers.resolveTicketSubjectTemplate loads titleTemplate, else '{{<titleFieldKey>}}' for legacy configs, else empty
Publish validation rejects ticket-creating definitions (executionMode ticket-only / ticket-plus-workflow) whose titleTemplate or descriptionPrefix references fields not insertable from the form

LEVERAGE pattern markers (template-token-insert / template-token-render) at BatchDuplicateTicketDialog insertToken, CannedResponseEditor insertMergeField, EE WorkflowTextTemplateEditor insertTextTemplateField and shared/rmm/alerts/ticketCreator.ts template render
